author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Brown opened Northeast Water Polo Conference play with a 14-10 win over Iona on Saturday at the New York Athletic Club’s Travers Island pool in Pelham, New York. The game was the conference’s first outdoor contest, and the Bears improved to 5-1 overall and 1-0 in league play.

Brown took a 4-2 lead in the first quarter and stayed ahead the rest of the way. Mac Berry scored the opening goal, Filip Josipovic and Ronland Csendes each struck twice in the period, and freshman Robert Norell recorded his first college goal. Csendes later completed his first hat trick of the season.

Dominik Balla scored three times in the fourth quarter, raising his season total to 15. Colton Bell and Hugo Molnar also scored in the final period. Goalkeeper Dimitrios Kratimenos made 14 saves through three quarters, and Ryan Miele added seven in the fourth. Brown travels to California next weekend for four games in the Fullerton area.
dek: The Bears led from the first quarter in the conference’s first outdoor game at the New York Athletic Club.
headline: Brown water polo earns first NWPC win with 14-10 victory at Iona
